rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and thinning zona, but the image does not clearly support a confidently 'tightly compact' A-grade ICM or uniformly cohesive TE; some described details (multinodular ICM, bleb at 2 o'clock) appear somewhat overinterpreted.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, diagnosis, BMI, prior cycle history, and sperm parameters well with embryo quality, though some links are slightly overstated and not all factors materially change prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the favorable profile; minor issues include additive-style modifiers without strong evidence basis and some overconfidence in specific effects.

Core assessment aligns reasonably with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, but recommendations such as routine aspirin consideration, ERA after a single failed transfer, PRP, NK/thrombophilia workup, and making PGT-A a first-line adjustment are not strongly guideline-supported in this scenario.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including luteal support and follow-up timing, but several suggested adjuncts/workups are more aggressive than necessary for a first-cycle unexplained infertility case.
